goal.description: An authenticated Gotify user pushes a malicious push message whose extras contain an intentUrl. On the vulnerable Android client, the WebSocketService parses the URL with Intent.parseUri and silently calls startActivity, launching an arbitrary exported activity in the gotify app's process context. On the clean client, the URL is wrapped in IntentUrlDialogActivity, which shows a confirmation dialog the user must approve.
goal.success_condition: The Android system's ActivityTaskManager logs a START line for the attacker-chosen component with 'from uid <gotify_uid>' as the caller, proving Intent.parseUri + startActivity ran in the gotify process.
